name: hyprexpo
label: HyprExpo Workspace Grid Overview
description: Provides an interactive grid overview of all workspaces with live thumbnails and touchpad gestures.

options.label: Grid Columns
options.description: Number of columns in the workspace overview grid.

options.label: Workspace Gaps
options.description: Spacing in pixels between workspace preview tiles.

options.label: Overview Background Color
options.description: Color and alpha of the overview backdrop.

options.label: Workspace Centering Method
options.description: Positioning algorithm when opening overview (e.g. 'center current', 'first 1').

options.label: Gesture Fingers
options.description: Finger count for the swipe gesture (3 or 4).

options.label: Gesture Distance
options.description: Touchpad swipe distance required to trigger overview.
